title: Tech View has its own saved Column Selection with Assigned Techs
custom_preconds:
Signed in as Admin (sees financial data), viewport 1024 px or wider
The admin's saved Work Orders view is reset over the API (display List), with no Tech View columns saved: Tech View shows its defaults, Service Advisor on and Assigned Techs off. The List's own column selection shows Service Advisor
A throwaway customer with a unique name of at most 30 characters and no pinned note, with one vehicle; seeding is pinned to the browser's current location
Two eligible technicians A and B. One work order for that customer with one line assigned to technician B, then lead technician A set, so the line keeps B

custom_steps_separated.content: Open /workorders, pick Tech View from the display switcher, and search for the unique customer name
custom_steps_separated.expected: The work order is a row under A's group; the table has a Service Advisor column and no Assigned Techs column

custom_steps_separated.content: Open Column Selection and turn on Assigned Techs
custom_steps_separated.expected: An Assigned Techs column appears at once, and the row shows A's avatar first, then B's
The Service Advisor column leaves the table at once

custom_steps_separated.content: Once the preference is saved, reload the page cold at the same URL
custom_steps_separated.expected: Tech View reopens; Assigned Techs is still shown with A's avatar first, and Service Advisor is still hidden

custom_steps_separated.content: Pick List from the display switcher and search for the unique customer name
custom_steps_separated.expected:
The List still shows its Service Advisor column

Tech View keeps a Column Selection of its own, saved to the account (Assigned Techs shows the lead first, and both choices survive a reload), while the List columns are left as they were
